title: SIDS Death Rates Fell Below Half Their Earlier Level
hook: The SIDS rate fell to 0.64 per thousand births after safer-sleep campaigning.
closing: A falling death rate is progress, but families still lose babies to sleep-related causes.
question: What helps families follow safer-sleep guidance?

segments.say: The later SIDS rate was 0.64 deaths per thousand live births. That was less than half the earlier rate.
Stomach-down placement accounted for 85.4% of cases in this comparison. Case shares alone are not a baby's individual risk.
Sleep-related infant deaths still total about 3,400 annually in the supplied count. That broader category is not identical to SIDS.
